_doc: Registry of retrieval run roots for TEST evaluation. One entry per line/root. glob is relative to outputs_root; layout 'cell/arm' = <glob>=.../<cell>/<arm>, 'r30flat' = .../r30*_<cell>_<arm>. A unit = dir with DONE.json + model_best.pth.tar (dirs named in exclude_arms are skipped). oracle=true marks ground-truth oracle diagnostics (not a method). host: in2r (IN2R VSE eval code in eval_code/). Datasets are read from the checkpoint opt and the cell name (f<noise>=Flickr30K, c<noise>=MS-COCO, cc=CC152K). Add a new experiment line by appending one entry.

exclude_arms.prefix: shared warm-up prefix state, not a trained unit
exclude_arms.calib: calibration dir, not a trained unit

lines.note: native IN2R fidelity checks: f20 = OFFICIAL NCR 0.2 index + R25 code-version config (H0_codecfg); f40/cc = author run.py defaults (H0_default) and defaults + --i2t --t2i (H0_default_i2t_t2i); code byte-identical to r25_in2r_20261027/code

lines.snapshot: handoff/r33_baselines_20261102/code_h0 (H0, byte copy of r25_in2r_20261027/code) | code_a1 (a1_iface, byte copy of r27_a1cross_20261030/code_a1x)
lines.note: benchmark baseline rows: H0 = native IN2R (R25 code-version config) and a1_iface = IN2R+A1, sharing one native prefix per cell (prefix kept outside runs/); cells c60/c20/c80 (COCO), f80/f20 (Flickr30K); 20% = OFFICIAL NCR index, 60% = R25 lock map, 80% = R33 NOISE_LOCK map; f20 has a1_iface only (its H0 is R31-FID f20 H0_codecfg, trained from scratch, not prefix-paired)

fixed_units.checkpoint_rule: FULLDEV.json best epoch (max full-DEV rSum, earliest tie; written 2026-10-29) -> checkpoint_<epoch>.pth.tar; SPS native model_best.pth.tar was selected on its 200-image DEV subset
